captions.facebook:
Build systems, not heroes. A good process should work without a single star employee. I put a 5-point system check on the last slide.

#Operations #SmallBusiness

Who in your business can't take a day off?
captions.linkedin:
If it only works when one person is there, it isn't a system.

Star employees are great. A business that depends on them is fragile. Where I'd start: the routines that repeat every day (opening and closing, customer service, ordering and receiving). Document them, standardize them, measure them.

The check: Is it written down? Can a new hire follow it? Is it the same everywhere? Is it measured? Who improves it?

#Operations #Leadership

What would break first if your best person took a month off?
